title: Would You Know What to Do If a Lift Stops?
summary: The lift jolts and stops between floors. Here is the calm, safe thing to do, and why you are safer inside than you think.

beats.text: The lift jolts and stops between floors. Do you pry the doors, press the alarm, or climb out?
Your heart races, your phone has one bar, and the doors are right there.

beats.reveal: Press the alarm or call button. Help knows where you are, and the lift is built to hold you safely.

beats.text: Then breathe slowly, stay inside, and call the number on the panel if you have signal.
Prying doors or climbing out is where people actually get hurt.
Bonus: the cars hang on several strong steel cables, so you cannot simply fall.

visual.text: A lift hangs on several cables and has safety brakes that grip the rails.
